link_type_attestation.vocab: data/vocab.json link types: uses_process means the other is the process that made this production possible.

link_type_attestation.judgment: uses_process is appropriate to the proposed relation: it asks whether the local crop cultivation employed the documented raised-plot process. This is a process-to-production relation, not an instrument-to-observation relation or assertion of transmission. Evidence and direction support the scoped question; candidate status retains uncertainty concerning location of banana planting.
